newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZSE to launch index of mid-capitalised stocks.
newsitem.headline: NZSE to launch index of mid-capitalised stocks.

text.p: The New Zealand Stock Exchange said on Friday it would launch a new NZSE Mid Cap index (NZSEMC) on April 7.
The index will measure the price trends of the 30 companies next by market capitalisation after the NZSE-10, and which meet liquidity criteria.
Only companies with the NZSE as their home exchange will be included.
The NZSEMC will have both a Gross and Capital version. The gross index is adjusted for dividends, so will not fall when companies go ex-dividend.
The NZSEMC is based on values of 2,678.01 and 1,901.43 for the Gross and Capital Indices respectively as at March 3.
